messages:
anya: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands runtime Q&A. Two requests for the kernel v2 canary: 1) a short ops checklist we can run during the 48h window, 2) recommended batch/cache defaults for chat workloads with 2-6 token bursts aiming for p50 <120ms. I'll paste our current test config below — curious if we should tweak it.

samir: Thanks Anya. Canary gates: smoke tests, latency SLOs, error rate, and memory/oom watch. We want an explicit abort threshold: p50 > 150ms or p95 > 400ms for more than 5 minutes -> automatic rollback. We'll share the gate script.

leo: For defaults we've been getting good results with small batch sizes and tight microbatch windows: max_batch_size=6, microbatch_window_ms=4, kv_prewarm=true. If you need lower mem, set kv_prewarm=false but enable kv_adaptive=true so cache warms on hot prefixes.

anya: Helpful. Jasper, any ops constraints for the Dedicated clusters?

jasper: Ops notes: ensure node drains are disabled for the canary pool, set autoscale to manual during the window, and pin canary to a few nodes with identical GPU types. We'll also want continuous trace sampling at 100% for canary-tagged requests.

diana: Add to that: tag traces with canary=kernel-v2 and batch_profile. We'll need batch_profile to map request size -> latency. Also, export KV hit ratio and avg microbatching delay.

leo: Example minimal config we recommend for the first pass: 
```yaml
runtime:
  kernel: v2
  pool: canary
batching:
  enabled: true
  microbatch_window_ms: 4
  max_batch_size: 6
cache:
  kv_prewarm: true
  kv_adaptive: true
  eviction_policy: lru
monitoring:
  trace_tag: canary=kernel-v2
  sample_rate: 100%
```

anya: Two roadmap questions: a) will kernel v2 include better quantization paths for int8? b) any ETA on multi-model routing (fallback to smaller model when load spikes)?

samir: a) yes, v2 has cleaner hooks for quantized kernels; int8 paths will be opt-in initially, we need to validate quality/regression. b) multi-model routing is on the Q2 roadmap; we hope to prototype a latency-first router in the next 6 weeks.

jasper: For the canary rollback action: infra-bot can trigger a rollback job but ops must confirm. Recommend an on-call runbook step: escalate to kernel-team if rollback hits twice in 24h.

infra-bot: canary deploy queued: job #4891 (kernel-v2) -> canary-pool-3. Estimated start 03:30 UTC.

anya: Perfect, thanks. I'll assemble the ops checklist and post it to the canary thread. If anyone has tuning scripts (sim load + latency asserts) please drop them here. :pray:
